text:
marta: FYI python-sdk 0.9.2 returns 404 on private models pin used by sampleapp onboarding. curl to REST works.

kai: can you share request/response?

marta: `POST /v1/private/models/pin` -> 404 `{"error": "Not found"}` but `curl /v1/enterprise/private/models/pin` -> 200.

sam-sdk: we rehomed private endpoints under /v1/enterprise for private tenants. SDK should map client.private.* to enterprise path when tenant_type=enterprise. looks like 0.9.2 missed that.

ci-bot: created issue RDW-4578 (sdk: private endpoint routing).

sam-sdk: plan: if client.config.tenant_type == 'enterprise' route to `/v1/enterprise/private/...`. add unit tests and docs. also add optional fallback: on 404 + `X-Enterprise-Suggest: true` header, retry enterprise once and warn.

marta: patched local wheel, onboarding now passes.

ci-bot: PR merged (sam-sdk).

sam-sdk: released 0.9.3 to PyPI with changelog note and quickstart docs updated.

olivia: added migration note about tenant_type in quickstart.

marta: verified staging build 1852500025  onboarding green.
